Before you order

Important ordering guidelines & policies

A few quick details before you order.

01 / DELIVERY

Where we deliver

Share your exact address. We will confirm coverage before you order.

02 / DELIVERY FEES

Know your total

Fees vary by location. Your delivery charge and final total are confirmed before ordering.

03 / PLAN AHEAD

Order ahead

Send your preferred date. We will confirm availability and preparation time.

04 / ARRIVAL TIME

Delivery timing

Choose your preferred time. We will agree on a delivery window when confirming your order.

05 / PAYMENT & CHANGES

Before you pay

Confirm payment and cancellation terms. Ask about changes or refunds before confirming. Burritos start from Tk 250; the full burrito is Tk 400.

06 / SERVING & STORAGE

Keep it fresh

Storage depends on your order. Ask us how to serve and store your food.

07 / ALLERGIES

Allergies?

Tell us before ordering. We will discuss ingredients and preparation with you.

08 / SHARED OCCASIONS

Feeding a group?

Share your date and guest count. We will help you choose quantities and check availability.
